videos.desc: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a couple hanging a picture frame shout at each other about where it should go, pointing fingers forehead to forehead with steam rising, then cool off, laugh and hang the picture together.
videos.said: I said to the left! No! It's perfect here!

videos.desc: A young woman with long dark hair in a striped pastel cardigan stands face to face with a young man in a grey T-shirt in a bright living room. With one arm crossed, she points her finger at him and talks at him with a stern face while he answers back. Then he looks up at the ceiling with his mouth open, trying to think of something to say, and she watches him with a small, satisfied smile. Behind them are a beige corner sofa with cushions, a wooden coffee table and white curtains.
videos.said: It was your fault. No, it was your fault. So name an example. I knew it, it was your fault.

videos.desc: In a 2D cartoon, a grandpa sets a camera on a tripod in the yard while a big multi-generation family gathers on the porch at dinner. He starts the timer, hurries over to join grandma, parents, kids and the dog, and the camera flashes for the group photo.
videos.said: Everybody, together now... Move up, move up! Cheese!

videos.desc: In a hand-painted anime street in the rain, a mustached man in a suit kneels to gather an old lady's spilled oranges, shelters her under his umbrella, opens the cafe door for her with "After you, please" and tips his hat as she thanks him.
videos.said: Allow me, madam. After you, please. Oh, how kind!

videos.desc: On a school playground, a girl with yellow ribbons in her pigtails skips rope, hops through a chalk hopscotch grid and jumps in a hula hoop while other girls watch; at the end she throws her arms up and her friends run in for a group hug.
videos.said: (bell ringing) - Hump, hump, two foot stretch, hump. Yes! (cheering)

videos.desc: A white-bearded old man in a cap spends the day with his young grandson: they reel in a fish on a lake dock, finish a wooden birdhouse in his workshop, and play chess in a park before he hugs the boy.

An animated young man with a backpack arrives at the family house at night; his father welcomes him at the door and calls to the tiny grandmother in her armchair, who reaches up, cups her grown grandson's face and hugs him.
videos.said: Mom, look who came. Oh, my boy's boy. Hi, Gran.

videos.desc: A young man welcomes an exhausted, cold woman home on a rainy evening, wraps a blanket around her shoulders and helps her out of her boots. He hands her a bowl of warm soup, strokes her head and holds her as she falls asleep on his shoulder.

On an old European town square, the camera moves between different men: a young man in a denim jacket scattering pigeons, a huge bearded man in an apron carrying a wooden crate, old men playing chess, and a man in a suit who shakes hands and hugs the young man.

On a sunny savanna, a family carries their table, chairs, a woven mat and a big pot of food out of their small house onto the grass. They set everything up in the open air and sit down to eat together in front of the house.
In a hand-drawn farmhouse kitchen a girl comes home through the door and her sister jumps up from breakfast to hug her; they pose together and then their mother joins the hug under a family portrait.
videos.said: Oh, finally! Mom, I'm back! My two girls.

videos.desc: On a rainy city street a woman drops her papers at a bus stop and an unknown man kneels to help gather them, shelters her under his umbrella, and walks her to the red double-decker bus, where she waves goodbye.
A mother sits on the living-room floor with her baby, who reaches for colorful wooden alphabet letters scattered on the wood floor. The baby coos and grabs at the toys while the mother smiles.

A married couple enjoys a morning at home: the woman flips a pancake while her husband claps, they clink coffee mugs, and she straightens his tie with her wedding ring in view before they flop onto the sofa laughing.

An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.
videos.said: Do you love your new car? I hate it! It's so embarrassing! But it's so cute!

videos.desc: A circus ring filmed from the dark audience seats. An elephant stands on a low round pedestal in a beam of light. Beside it stands a clown in a yellow and purple polka-dot costume with a bright orange wig, huge yellow shoes and a white painted face, next to a man in a dark red suit. A big dark cloth drops over the elephant and hides it completely; the clown throws both arms up in the air towards the audience. When the cloth is pulled away, a white tiger is sitting on the pedestal instead. The clown lies down on the sawdust beside the tiger with its legs in the air while the audience films on their phones.

A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.
videos.said: It is Grandpa's 100th birthday. Time to surprise her with a huge gift.

videos.desc: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.
videos.said: Time to surprise grandma with the best birthday gift ever. Surprise! Happy birthday, young lady. I love you.

videos.desc: A very old woman with white hair, in a lilac coat and scarf, walks slowly up a narrow cobbled street of tiled houses with a wooden walking stick. A young man in an apron and a nurse in blue scrubs walk on either side of her, each holding an arm, and several neighbours follow behind. At the top they help her up the stone steps to a blue tiled doorway, and she turns round at the door, smiling, with the little group gathered round her.

A backyard party at sunset. A man in a denim shirt and backwards cap flips burgers on a smoking barbecue. He then turns and holds out a plate with a huge stacked burger to a small boy in a striped t-shirt, who throws his fists up and shouts with delight. The man plays catch on the lawn with a leather glove, and finally sits on the tailgate of a red pickup while the guests behind him cheer with raised cups.

An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.

Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.

A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.

A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.

A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

A silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit moves through a city. He holds a cafe door open and waves someone ahead of him inside. In a marble shopping arcade he bends down and picks up a blue patterned scarf that a passer-by has dropped. At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.
